| 2026-03-19 | phase4 | **Phase 4.49: MLA + torch.compile optimizations + attn_res block_attn compile path** — (1) **MultiHeadLatentAttention** (`src/models/attention/multihead_latent_attention.py`): NEW module — decoupled RoPE MLA (DeepSeek-V2 style); content path compresses x→latent then projects Q and fused KV; separate rope path projects from raw x, applies RoPE, concatenates to content Q/K heads; all four backends (flash/xformers/sage/standard) supported; GQA/MQA via `num_kv_heads`; `mla_latent_dim` config field; wired through `make_attention`, `TransformerBlock`, `LearningModel`. (2) **AttnResidual `forward_stacked()`** (`src/models/residual/attn_residual.py`): compile-friendly path accepting pre-stacked `(B,T,max_sources,d)` tensor + `valid_sources` int; masked softmax zeros out padding slots via `torch.arange` + `masked_fill`; `forward()` delegates to it; zero-init queries give uniform softmax at init (averaging warm-start). (3) **LearningModel block_attn path** (`src/models/learning_model/learning_model.py`): `_apply_blocks_block_attn_res` pre-stacks to fixed `max_sources=N+1`, zero-pads to full width, calls `ar.forward_stacked()`; eliminates dynamic `torch.stack` variable shape in hot loop. (4) **torch.compile config knobs** (`src/config/training.py`): added `torch_compile_mode: Literal[...] | None`, `torch_compile_fullgraph: bool`, `torch_compile_dynamic: bool`; existing configs unchanged (all default to None/False). (5) **Sage auto-disable + compile tuning** (`src/training/train.py`): sage attention backend auto-disables torch.compile with warning; config knobs for mode/fullgraph/dynamic honored; distributed max-autotune overridden to "default" with warning; improved compile logging. (6) **cudagraph boundary fix** (`src/training/loop.py`): `torch.compiler.cudagraph_mark_step_begin()` moved to **first** micro-step of each accumulation window (was last); correct boundary placement for overlapping capture regions. (7) **Causal mask cache** (`src/models/attention/causal_mha.py`, `multihead_latent_attention.py`): `_causal_bias_cache` dict keyed by `(T, device.type, device.index, dtype)` avoids per-forward allocation; xFormers combined-bias path uses cached tensor; **fixed SDPA `attn_mask + is_causal=True` error** — when additive position bias is present, combine `causal + attn_bias` and pass `is_causal=False` (PyTorch SDPA forbids both simultaneously). (8) **Test additions**: `test_forward_stacked_matches_list_path` in `test_attn_residual.py`; MLA shape/gradient/GQA tests in `test_attention.py`; compile config field tests in `test_config.py`; cudagraph boundary test in `test_training_loop.py`. TorchDynamo explain on block_attn+standard: 1 graph, 0 breaks. 680 tests passing. All gates: test-quick ✅, ruff ✅, mypy ✅, black ✅. |
| 2026-03-18 | phase4 | **Phase 4.48: add SlidingWindowAttention, ResidualLinearAttention + config/README sync** — (1) `src/models/attention/sliding_window_attention.py`: `SlidingWindowAttention` — causal attention restricted to a band of `window_size` preceding tokens; Flash Attention 2 backend uses native `window_size=(W-1, 0)` param; standard/fallback backend builds a band-diagonal causal mask via `F.scaled_dot_product_attention`; GQA/MQA + RoPE + ALiBi all supported. (2) `src/models/attention/residual_linear_attention.py`: `ResidualLinearAttention` — O(T·D²) causal linear attention via ELU+1 feature map (Katharopoulos et al. 2020) using cumulative outer products (`KV_cum = Σ_{j≤i} outer(φ(k_j), v_j)`); learned input residual `res_proj(x)` added to prevent rank collapse; GQA/MQA supported; RoPE rejected with clear error. (3) `src/models/attention/__init__.py`: `make_attention(attn_type, ...)` factory dispatching `"mha"` / `"swa"` / `"rla"`; exports all three classes. (4) `src/config/model.py`: `attn_type: str = "mha"` and `swa_window_size: int = 256` fields; `_validate_attn_type()` validates type + rejects `rla+rope` combination. (5) `TransformerBlock` and `LearningModel` updated to use `make_attention` factory; `from_config` passes both new fields. (6) `tests/unit/test_attention.py`: 15 new tests (7 SWA: output shape, causal masking, window constraint, gradient flow, GQA, window=1, assertion; 8 RLA: output shape, dtype, causal masking, rope-raises, gradient flow, has-res_proj, GQA, different-inputs); 38 tests total passing. (7) `config/README.md`: added `attn_type` and `swa_window_size` rows to `[model]` table; updated Phase 4 Llama example to add `num_kv_heads`/`attn_type`; added SWA and RLA example snippets with complexity/compatibility notes. All gates: test-quick ✅, ruff ✅, mypy ✅, black ✅. |

| 2026-03-18 | phase4 | **Phase 4.48: implement Attention Residuals (AttnRes) + doc sync** — Implemented two variants of Attention Residuals (Kimi Team 2025) replacing fixed additive residuals with learned depth-wise softmax attention: (1) **`full_attn`** — each sublayer's input is computed via softmax attention over all prior sublayer outputs (O(L²)); (2) **`block_attn`** — layers grouped into N blocks (`attn_res_num_blocks`, default 8), attention over N block-level summaries (O(N²)); paper shows 1.25× compute advantage at N≈8 vs baseline. All query vectors zero-initialized (paper requirement: uniform weights at init = equivalent to standard residuals). RMSNorm on keys prevents high-magnitude layers dominating weights. Implementation: `src/models/residual/attn_residual.py` (`AttnResidual` module with learnable queries + key norm + final aggregation query); `TransformerBlock.apply_attn_only()` / `apply_ffn_only()` expose sublayer outputs without residual add; `LearningModel._apply_blocks_full_attn_res()` / `_apply_blocks_block_attn_res()` dispatch from `_apply_transformer_blocks()`; `ModelConfig` fields `res_type` (validated, default `"standard"`) and `attn_res_num_blocks` (validated divisibility). 34 unit tests in `tests/unit/test_attn_residual.py` covering shape, grad flow, zero-init behavior, sublayer methods, config validation, `from_config` integration. Doc sync: `docs/DESIGN.md` status line, `docs/PLAN.md` Phase 4 components, `config/README.md` model config table. Gates: `make test-quick` ✅, `ruff check` ✅, `mypy` ✅, `black --check` ✅. |
